desc.de: Streaming-Plattform: Data Streams (Echtzeit-Ingestion), Data Firehose (ETL → S3/Redshift/OpenSearch), Managed Service for Apache Flink (ehem. Data Analytics; SQL-Variante seit 27.01.2026 eingestellt), Video Streams. Serverless, auto-skalierend.
desc.en: Streaming platform: Data Streams (real-time ingestion), Data Firehose (ETL → S3/Redshift/OpenSearch), Managed Service for Apache Flink (formerly Data Analytics; SQL variant discontinued 2026-01-27), Video Streams. Serverless, auto-scaling.

tcpDesc.de: ⚠️ DIS (Data Ingestion Service, direktes Kinesis-Pendant) ist seit 01.07.2025 EOL! DMS Kafka ist die verbleibende Lösung: Managed Kafka 2.3.0/2.7/3.x, Multi-AZ, SASL/SSL, Consumer Groups, 3–50 Broker (Single-Node-Instanzen möglich). Kein Serverless — Broker-Flavors (kafka.2u4g–16u32g) und Broker-Anzahl fest wählen. Smart Connect repliziert zwischen Kafka-Instanzen und dumpt Topics nach OBS. Für Stream Analytics DLI Flink Jobs oder MRS Flink/Spark Streaming.
tcpDesc.en: ⚠️ DIS (Data Ingestion Service, direct Kinesis equivalent) has been EOL since 01.07.2025! DMS Kafka is the remaining solution: Managed Kafka 2.3.0/2.7/3.x, multi-AZ, SASL/SSL, consumer groups, 3–50 brokers (single-node instances available). No serverless — choose broker flavor (kafka.2u4g–16u32g) and broker count. Smart Connect replicates between Kafka instances and dumps topics to OBS. For stream analytics DLI Flink jobs or MRS Flink/Spark Streaming.

alt.de: DMS Kafka, DLI Flink, MRS Spark Streaming, OBS (Batch)
alt.en: DMS Kafka, DLI Flink, MRS Spark Streaming, OBS (batch)

migration.de: **DIS ist EOL.** Data Ingestion Service (direktes Kinesis-Pendant) wurde am 01.07.2025 abgeschaltet — nicht als Migrationsziel verwenden. **Service-Mapping.** Kinesis Data Streams → DMS Kafka Topics mit Partitions. Data Firehose (Delivery Streams) → DMS Kafka Smart Connect (Dump nach OBS); Transformationen/andere Ziele über FunctionGraph-Consumer selbst bauen. Lambda Event Source Mapping → FunctionGraph DMS-Kafka-Trigger. **Analytics & Video.** Managed Service for Apache Flink (ehem. Kinesis Data Analytics) → DLI Flink Jobs (serverless), MRS Flink oder Flink auf CCE. Kinesis Video Streams hat kein T Cloud Public-Pendant — externe Lösung nötig.
migration.en: **DIS is EOL.** Data Ingestion Service (direct Kinesis equivalent) was shut down on 2025-07-01 — do not use as migration target. **Service mapping.** Kinesis Data Streams → DMS Kafka topics with partitions. Data Firehose (delivery streams) → DMS Kafka Smart Connect (dump to OBS); build transformations/other targets yourself via FunctionGraph consumers. Lambda Event Source Mapping → FunctionGraph DMS Kafka trigger. **Analytics & Video.** Managed Service for Apache Flink (formerly Kinesis Data Analytics) → DLI Flink jobs (serverless), MRS Flink or Flink on CCE. Kinesis Video Streams has no T Cloud Public equivalent — external solution needed.

equivNote.de: DIS (direktes Kinesis-Pendant) ist EOL seit 01.07.2025. DMS Kafka deckt Streaming ab, ist aber Broker-basiert (nicht serverless wie Kinesis). Firehose nur teilweise: Smart Connect dumpt Kafka-Topics nach OBS (keine Transformation, keine weiteren Ziele). Flink-Analytics → DLI/MRS Flink. Kein Video Streams. Capacity Planning nötig (keine On-Demand-Shard-Skalierung).
equivNote.en: DIS (direct Kinesis equivalent) is EOL since 01.07.2025. DMS Kafka covers streaming but is broker-based (not serverless like Kinesis). Firehose only partially: Smart Connect dumps Kafka topics to OBS (no transformation, no other targets). Flink analytics → DLI/MRS Flink. No Video Streams. Capacity planning required (no on-demand shard scaling).

tfNote.de: Kafka-Instanz und Topics per Terraform; der Firehose-ähnliche Dump nach OBS ist als Smart-Connect-Task (destination_type OBS_SINK) per Terraform abbildbar.
tfNote.en: Kafka instance and topics via Terraform; the Firehose-like dump to OBS can be defined as a Smart Connect task (destination_type OBS_SINK) via Terraform.

desc.de: Serverless Message Queuing. Standard (best-effort ordering, at-least-once) und FIFO Queues (exactly-once, ordered). Dead Letter Queues, Long Polling, Batch Operations, Message Timer, bis 1 MiB.
desc.en: Serverless message queuing. Standard (best-effort ordering, at-least-once) and FIFO queues (exactly-once, ordered). Dead letter queues, long polling, batch operations, message timer, up to 1 MiB.

tcpDesc.de: DMS bietet Managed Kafka und seit 05/2026 DMS for RocketMQ 5.x (GA, EU-DE/EU-NL) als Queue-Alternativen. RocketMQ kommt SQS-Semantik am nächsten: Ordered Messages, Delayed/Scheduled Messages (bis 7 Tage), Retry- und Dead-Letter-Queues, Tag-Filterung, Transaktionsnachrichten, bis 4 MB pro Nachricht. Broker-basiert (nicht serverless) — Single/Cluster-Instanzen provisionieren. Managed RabbitMQ wird nicht angeboten (weder in Leistungsbeschreibung noch Doku). Kafka und RocketMQ sind per Terraform provisionierbar.
tcpDesc.en: DMS offers managed Kafka and, since 05/2026, DMS for RocketMQ 5.x (GA, EU-DE/EU-NL) as queue alternatives. RocketMQ is closest to SQS semantics: ordered messages, delayed/scheduled messages (up to 7 days), retry and dead-letter queues, tag filtering, transactional messages, up to 4 MB per message. Broker-based (not serverless) — provision single/cluster instances. Managed RabbitMQ is not offered (neither in the service description nor the docs). Kafka and RocketMQ are provisionable via Terraform.

alt.de: Kafka auf CCE, RabbitMQ self-managed auf CCE, Redis Queues
alt.en: Kafka on CCE, self-managed RabbitMQ on CCE, Redis Queues

migration.de: **Protokollwechsel.** SQS ist eine HTTP-API (Pull), RocketMQ nutzt eigene Client-SDKs (TCP/gRPC) — Producer- und Consumer-Code umschreiben. Broker statt Managed Queue. **Ordering & DLQ.** FIFO Queues → RocketMQ Ordered Messages (Reihenfolge pro Queue). Dead Letter Queues → RocketMQ Retry- und Dead-Letter-Queues. Delay Queues/Message Timer → Delayed/Scheduled Messages (bis 7 Tage). **Feature-Mapping.** Message Attributes → RocketMQ Tags/Properties (Tag-Filterung). Nachrichten bis 4 MB. **Kein RabbitMQ.** DMS for RabbitMQ ist auf T Cloud Public nicht verfügbar; AMQP-basierte Lösungen nur self-managed auf ECS/CCE. **Terraform.** RocketMQ-Instanzen, Topics, User und Consumer Groups per Terraform (dms_rocketmq_*).
migration.en: **Protocol change.** SQS is an HTTP API (pull), RocketMQ uses its own client SDKs (TCP/gRPC) — rewrite producer and consumer code. Broker instead of managed queue. **Ordering & DLQ.** FIFO queues → RocketMQ ordered messages (order per queue). Dead letter queues → RocketMQ retry and dead-letter queues. Delay queues/message timers → delayed/scheduled messages (up to 7 days). **Feature mapping.** Message attributes → RocketMQ tags/properties (tag filtering). Messages up to 4 MB. **No RabbitMQ.** DMS for RabbitMQ is not available on T Cloud Public; AMQP-based solutions only self-managed on ECS/CCE. **Terraform.** RocketMQ instances, topics, users and consumer groups via Terraform (dms_rocketmq_*).

equivNote.de: DMS for RocketMQ ist Broker-basiert (nicht serverless wie SQS) und nutzt RocketMQ-SDKs statt HTTP-API. Ordered Messages, Delay bis 7 Tage, Retry- und Dead-Letter-Queues sowie Tag-Filterung decken die SQS-Kernsemantik weitgehend ab. Kein Managed RabbitMQ. Kapazitätsplanung nötig.
equivNote.en: DMS for RocketMQ is broker-based (not serverless like SQS) and uses RocketMQ SDKs instead of an HTTP API. Ordered messages, delays up to 7 days, retry and dead-letter queues and tag filtering largely cover SQS core semantics. No managed RabbitMQ. Capacity planning required.

tfNote.de: RocketMQ (Instanz, Topics, Consumer Groups, User) und Kafka sind per Terraform provisionierbar.
tfNote.en: RocketMQ (instance, topics, consumer groups, users) and Kafka are provisionable via Terraform.

desc.de: Pub/Sub Messaging + Mobile Push. Standard/FIFO Topics, Message Filtering (Attribute-basiert), Fan-out zu SQS/Lambda/HTTP, Mobile Push (APNs/FCM), SMS, Email.
desc.en: Pub/Sub messaging + mobile push. Standard/FIFO topics, message filtering (attribute-based), fan-out to SQS/Lambda/HTTP, mobile push (APNs/FCM), SMS, email.

tcpDesc.de: Pub/Sub mit Topics und Subscriptions. Protokolle: HTTP/HTTPS, Email, SMS, FunctionGraph. Topic-basiertes Fan-out, Template-basierte Nachrichten. Kein Mobile Push (APNs/FCM), keine FIFO Topics. Subscription-Filter-Policies auf Message-Attribute (seit 03/2026). Max 10.000 Subscriptions pro Topic.
tcpDesc.en: Pub/sub with topics and subscriptions. Protocols: HTTP/HTTPS, email, SMS, FunctionGraph. Topic-based fan-out, template-based messages. No mobile push (APNs/FCM), no FIFO topics. Subscription filter policies on message attributes (since 03/2026). Max 10,000 subscriptions per topic.

migration.de: **Kein Mobile Push.** APNs/GCM werden nicht unterstützt — Firebase oder OneSignal extern anbinden. **Kein FIFO.** Ordering muss applikationsseitig gelöst werden. **Filter Policies.** SNS-Filter-Policies in SMN-Subscription-Filter-Policies (string_equals auf Message-Attribute) übertragen — komplexere Filterlogik in FunctionGraph verlagern. **Fan-out-Pattern.** SNS + SQS Fan-out → SMN + DMS RocketMQ/Kafka via FunctionGraph-Bridge. Cross-Region Delivery gibt es nicht.
migration.en: **No mobile push.** APNs/GCM are not supported — integrate Firebase or OneSignal externally. **No FIFO.** Ordering must be handled application-side. **Filter policies.** Transfer SNS filter policies to SMN subscription filter policies (string_equals on message attributes) — move more complex filter logic to FunctionGraph. **Fan-out pattern.** SNS + SQS fan-out → SMN + DMS RocketMQ/Kafka via FunctionGraph bridge. Cross-region delivery does not exist.

equivNote.de: SMN unterstützt HTTP/HTTPS, Email, SMS und FunctionGraph-Subscriptions (DMS als Protokoll seit 05/2023 entfernt). Kein Mobile Push (APNs/FCM — Firebase/OneSignal nutzen). Keine FIFO Topics. Attributbasierte Subscription-Filter-Policies seit 03/2026 (string_equals). Max 10.000 Subscriptions/Topic. Template-basierte Nachrichten für formatierte Benachrichtigungen.
equivNote.en: SMN supports HTTP/HTTPS, email, SMS and FunctionGraph subscriptions (DMS removed as protocol in 05/2023). No mobile push (APNs/FCM — use Firebase/OneSignal). No FIFO topics. Attribute-based subscription filter policies since 03/2026 (string_equals). Max 10,000 subscriptions/topic. Template-based messages for formatted notifications.

desc.de: Simple Email Service. Transaktions-E-Mails, Massen-E-Mails, SMTP-Interface, Bounce/Complaint Handling, Dedicated IPs.
desc.en: Simple Email Service. Transactional emails, bulk emails, SMTP interface, bounce/complaint handling, dedicated IPs.

tcpDesc.de: SMTP-Relay für ausgehende E-Mails aus T Cloud Public (Ports 465/587, Authentifizierung, bis ca. 100 Mails/Minute). Kein Managed Email-Dienst: kein Inbound-Empfang, kein Bounce-/Complaint-Management, keine Templates, keine Dedicated IPs/Reputation-Dashboards.
tcpDesc.en: SMTP relay for outbound e-mails from T Cloud Public (ports 465/587, authentication, up to approx. 100 mails/minute). Not a managed e-mail service: no inbound receiving, no bounce/complaint management, no templates, no dedicated IPs/reputation dashboards.

migration.de: **Secure Mail Gateway für System-Mails.** Transaktionale Mails mit geringem Volumen (Benachrichtigungen, Passwort-Resets) können über das SMTP-Relay von T Cloud Public versendet werden — SES-SMTP-Credentials durch Secure-Mail-Gateway-Zugangsdaten ersetzen. **Keine SES-API.** Anwendungen, die die SES-API (SendEmail/SendTemplatedEmail) nutzen, auf SMTP umstellen. **Hohes Volumen & Inbound.** Für Marketing-/Bulk-Mails, Inbound-Verarbeitung und Bounce-Handling externe Anbieter (SendGrid, Mailgun, Brevo) oder SES cross-cloud nutzen. **DNS-Umstellung.** SPF-, DKIM- und DMARC-Records an das neue Relay anpassen. **IP Warmup.** Bei externen Anbietern mit Dedicated IPs 2–4 Wochen Warmup einplanen.
migration.en: **Secure Mail Gateway for system mails.** Low-volume transactional mails (notifications, password resets) can be sent via the T Cloud Public SMTP relay — replace SES SMTP credentials with Secure Mail Gateway credentials. **No SES API.** Switch applications using the SES API (SendEmail/SendTemplatedEmail) to SMTP. **High volume & inbound.** For marketing/bulk mails, inbound processing and bounce handling use external providers (SendGrid, Mailgun, Brevo) or SES cross-cloud. **DNS changes.** Adjust SPF, DKIM and DMARC records for the new relay. **IP warmup.** Plan 2–4 weeks of warmup for external providers with dedicated IPs.

equivNote.de: Secure Mail Gateway deckt nur ausgehenden SMTP-Versand mit geringem Volumen ab. Kein SES-API, keine Receipt Rules, kein Configuration-Set/Event-Publishing, kein Bulk-Versand.
equivNote.en: Secure Mail Gateway only covers low-volume outbound SMTP sending. No SES API, no receipt rules, no configuration sets/event publishing, no bulk sending.

desc.de: Managed Message Broker. ActiveMQ und RabbitMQ. AMQP, MQTT, STOMP, OpenWire. Multi-AZ, Persistence, Encryption.
desc.en: Managed message broker. ActiveMQ and RabbitMQ. AMQP, MQTT, STOMP, OpenWire. Multi-AZ, persistence, encryption.

tcpDesc.de: Kein Managed ActiveMQ oder RabbitMQ (RabbitMQ fehlt in Leistungsbeschreibung und Doku). Broker-basiertes Messaging über DMS for RocketMQ 5.x (GA seit 05/2026, EU-DE/EU-NL): Single-/Cluster-Instanzen, Ordered/Delayed/Transactional Messages, Retry/DLQ, SSL. Konsolen-Assistent zur Migration von RabbitMQ-Metadaten nach RocketMQ.
tcpDesc.en: No managed ActiveMQ or RabbitMQ (RabbitMQ is missing from the service description and docs). Broker-based messaging via DMS for RocketMQ 5.x (GA since 05/2026, EU-DE/EU-NL): single/cluster instances, ordered/delayed/transactional messages, retry/DLQ, SSL. Console wizard to migrate RabbitMQ metadata to RocketMQ.

alt.de: ActiveMQ/RabbitMQ self-managed auf ECS/CCE, DMS Kafka (für Pub/Sub-Patterns)
alt.en: Self-managed ActiveMQ/RabbitMQ on ECS/CCE, DMS Kafka (for pub/sub patterns)

migration.de: **Kein Managed ActiveMQ/RabbitMQ.** Protokollkompatibel nur mit self-managed Brokern auf ECS/CCE (geringster Code-Aufwand). **Umstieg auf RocketMQ.** Alternativ Clients auf RocketMQ-SDKs umschreiben — AMQP, MQTT, STOMP und OpenWire werden nicht unterstützt. **Metadaten-Migration.** RabbitMQ-Definitions exportieren und über die RocketMQ-Konsole migrieren (Queues/Exchanges → Topics/Consumer Groups). **Terraform.** RocketMQ-Instanzen, Topics, User und Consumer Groups per Terraform (dms_rocketmq_*).
migration.en: **No managed ActiveMQ/RabbitMQ.** Protocol-compatible only with self-managed brokers on ECS/CCE (lowest code effort). **Switch to RocketMQ.** Alternatively rewrite clients to RocketMQ SDKs — AMQP, MQTT, STOMP and OpenWire are not supported. **Metadata migration.** Export RabbitMQ definitions and migrate them via the RocketMQ console (queues/exchanges → topics/consumer groups). **Terraform.** RocketMQ instances, topics, users and consumer groups via Terraform (dms_rocketmq_*).

equivNote.de: Weder ActiveMQ noch RabbitMQ als Managed Service. DMS for RocketMQ bietet Broker-basiertes Messaging mit eigenem Protokoll — JMS/AMQP/MQTT/STOMP-Clients müssen umgeschrieben oder Broker self-managed betrieben werden.
equivNote.en: Neither ActiveMQ nor RabbitMQ as a managed service. DMS for RocketMQ offers broker-based messaging with its own protocol — JMS/AMQP/MQTT/STOMP clients must be rewritten or brokers self-managed.

tfNote.de: DMS for RocketMQ ist per Terraform steuerbar (Instanz, Topics, User, Consumer Groups); für ActiveMQ/RabbitMQ gibt es keinen Managed Service.
tfNote.en: DMS for RocketMQ is manageable via Terraform (instance, topics, users, consumer groups); there is no managed service for ActiveMQ/RabbitMQ.

desc.de: Managed Apache Kafka. Serverless und Provisioned. Multi-AZ, Schema Registry (Glue), MSK Connect, Tiered Storage.
desc.en: Managed Apache Kafka. Serverless and provisioned. Multi-AZ, Schema Registry (Glue), MSK Connect, tiered storage.

tcpDesc.de: Managed Kafka-Instanzen. Multi-AZ, Consumer Groups, Topic Management, SASL/SSL. Smart Connect (Replikation zwischen Kafka-Instanzen, Dump nach OBS). Kein Serverless-Modus, weniger Kafka-Versionen als MSK (2.3.0, 2.7, 3.x).
tcpDesc.en: Managed Kafka instances. Multi-AZ, consumer groups, topic management, SASL/SSL. Smart Connect (replication between Kafka instances, dump to OBS). No serverless mode, fewer Kafka versions than MSK (2.3.0, 2.7, 3.x).

alt.de: Self-managed Kafka auf CCE (Strimzi Operator), Redpanda auf CCE
alt.en: Self-managed Kafka on CCE (Strimzi Operator), Redpanda on CCE

migration.de: **Versionskompatibilität.** DMS Kafka unterstützt weniger Kafka-Versionen als MSK — vor Migration prüfen. **Kein Serverless.** MSK Serverless hat kein Pendant — DMS braucht feste Instanzgröße (Capacity Planning erforderlich). **Fehlende Managed-Komponenten.** MSK Connect (Managed Kafka Connect) → DMS Smart Connect (nur Kafka-Replikation und OBS-Dump), sonst Kafka Connect self-hosted auf CCE. Schema Registry (Glue) → Confluent Schema Registry auf CCE. Cruise Control → manuelles Partition-Rebalancing. Tiered Storage nicht verfügbar. **Authentifizierung.** IAM-basierte Auth gibt es nicht — DMS nur SASL/PLAIN oder SCRAM-SHA-512. **Live-Migration.** MirrorMaker 2 oder Smart Connect für die Übergangsphase von MSK zu DMS Kafka nutzen.
migration.en: **Version compatibility.** DMS Kafka supports fewer Kafka versions than MSK — check before migration. **No serverless.** MSK Serverless has no equivalent — DMS needs fixed instance size (capacity planning required). **Missing managed components.** MSK Connect (managed Kafka Connect) → DMS Smart Connect (Kafka replication and OBS dump only), otherwise self-hosted Kafka Connect on CCE. Schema Registry (Glue) → Confluent Schema Registry on CCE. Cruise Control → manual partition rebalancing. Tiered Storage not available. **Authentication.** IAM-based auth does not exist — DMS only SASL/PLAIN or SCRAM-SHA-512. **Live migration.** Use MirrorMaker 2 or Smart Connect for transition phase from MSK to DMS Kafka.

equivNote.de: DMS Kafka bietet managed Kafka-Instanzen mit SASL/SSL. Kein MSK Serverless, kein generisches MSK Connect (nur Smart Connect für Kafka-Replikation/OBS-Dump), kein Tiered Storage, weniger Kafka-Versionen, keine IAM-basierte Authentifizierung. Schema Registry muss selbst betrieben werden.
equivNote.en: DMS Kafka provides managed Kafka instances with SASL/SSL. No MSK Serverless, no generic MSK Connect (only Smart Connect for Kafka replication/OBS dump), no tiered storage, fewer Kafka versions, no IAM-based authentication. Schema Registry must be self-operated.

tfNote.de: DMS-Kafka-Instanzen, Topics, Benutzer, Berechtigungen, Consumer Groups sowie Smart Connect (Instanz und Tasks, z.B. Kafka-Replikation oder Dump nach OBS) sind per Terraform steuerbar.
tfNote.en: DMS Kafka instances, topics, users, permissions, consumer groups and Smart Connect (instance and tasks, e.g. Kafka replication or dump to OBS) can be managed via Terraform.
